plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 12 Feb 1892 & 1898 (Dmitri Ivanovsky shows tobacco mosaic sap stays infectious through a bacteria-blocking Chamberland porcelain filter; Martinus Beijerinck proves replication in living tissue and names it a 'virus') · 1915–1917 (Frederick Twort & Félix d'Hérelle discover bacteria-eating viruses, bacteriophages) · 28 June 1935 & Dec 1936 (Wendell Stanley crystallises Tobacco Mosaic Virus like salt; Bawden & Pirie prove it is 95% protein and 5% RNA; Helmut Ruska photographs viruses in 1938–1939) · 20 Sep 1952 (Alfred Hershey & Martha Chase use 35S/32P radioactive phages and a Waring blender to prove viruses inject pure DNA to hijack cells).
